limitations: Read-only consistency audit: does not execute Windows PEs, re-run the game oracle, rebuild, emulate instructions, or invoke SMT.
Windows native execution remains the authority for observed native outputs; retained file checks alone cannot independently authenticate observation capture.
Trace executions are Unicorn runs of exact linked PE bytes and are separate from native Windows process observations.
Recorded object byte/relocation equivalence is hash-bound; disposable COFF objects are not required.

Temporal native controllers implement stateless projection only. Ordered server reducer observations do not mean the PE implements timer scheduling, persistence, occupancy arbitration or event acceptance.
Bogus-code proof is conditional on ordinary entry, intact code/flags, successful loads and normal calls; unobserved blocks alone are not proof.
No live campaign integration, authored geometry or physics change is certified by this package.
